entities.summary: Joshua Lanier Martin was an American politician who served as the 12th governor of Alabama from 1845 to 1847 as an Independent, and is the only Independent Governor in the state's history. He had also served as a representative to the United States Congress for Alabama's 2nd district from 1835 to 1839 as a Democrat.
